svg.aria-label: A request sorter on a bench, standing for a Jokuh agent's approval rules. Capsules marked with one to six bands (read, organize, write, send, spend, delete) drop from an intake tube onto a carriage that sorts them into three troughs. The near trough runs read and organize requests straight to a Done tray, where a printer issues a receipt, with an Undo tab for organize. The middle trough takes write requests only while the owner's Ask/Auto switch is on Auto, which holds its entrance flap open; on Ask, writes are sorted to the far trough instead. The far trough stops send, spend and delete at a locked gate that only the owner's lever opens. A coin column on the left fills toward the monthly budget cap.
